subject: Quick pilot recap + request for a short quote and 1-minute clip
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearcommerce.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap — metrics & next steps

Hey Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks again for a tight POC. The ClearCommerce team wrapped internal verification today and the numbers look solid. Quick recap from our side (TL;DR attached):

- Conversion uplift on cart confirmations: +8.6% (baseline -> pilot)
- Median latency to first token: 210ms (peak 280ms)
- Monthly cost-savings estimate (projection if rolled to prod): ~$24k/mo
- Error rate on reranks: 0.2% (within SLA target)

We attached the pilot_metrics_dashboard.pdf with the dashboards your team shared and our internal signoff notes.

We are open to being a reference customer — we can provide a short quote and do a 60–90s video clip, but need to confirm what metrics you plan to publish (some of the numbers above are OK, others we need to anonymize). Also please share the script/ questions you intend to use for the clip.

Can we lock a 15-minute call next week to finalize? Wednesday or Thursday morning PST work for us.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Product Operations
ClearCommerce

Attachment: pilot_metrics_dashboard.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearcommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Apr 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap — metrics & next steps

Elena — really appreciate the quick sign-off and the detailed notes. Great to hear the conversion lift landed where we expected.

Quick replies and a proposed plan:

1) Metrics publication: we will only publish the high-level numbers you approve. If you want specific figures redacted (e.g., exact cost savings), we’ll show a rounded estimate or percent uplift instead.

2) Quote & clip: thank you for agreeing to both. For the quote, a single-sentence attribution (name + title + 1 line) is perfect for our site. For the clip, we’ll aim for ~60 seconds. Marketing will produce a short prompt/script and keep edits to a minimum.

3) Scheduling: we can do Wed 11:00–11:30 PT or Thu 09:00–09:30 PT. If neither works, suggest alternatives and we’ll adapt.

I’ve attached a proposed 1-minute question script to speed the call — purely optional.

Thanks again — small ask on logistics below in case you want to approve ahead of time:
- Approved metrics to publish (list or confirm attached PDF)
- Exact quote wording (we can draft and you can edit)
- Preferred clip time slot

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: 1min_clip_script_v1.txt (inline)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearcommerce.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Apr 2028 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap — metrics & next steps

Marcus — thanks for the script. ClearCommerce is OK to proceed with the following constraints:

- Publishable metrics: +8.6% conversion uplift (we’re comfortable publishing uplift %), median latency (rounded to ~210ms) but please remove the peak number, and "estimated cost savings ~$24k/mo" should be presented as "~$24k/mo (customer-provided estimate)".
- Quote (you may use the text below as-is or trim):

"Redwood Inference helped us move from experiment to measurable lift in a matter of weeks — the conversion improvements are already noticeable in our funnels." — Elena Ruiz, Director, Product Operations, ClearCommerce

- Clip: we can record a 60-second piece next Thursday (Apr 14), 10:00–10:20 PT. We’ll need a short pre-call to align the script (5 minutes).

I attached the signed_poc_summary.docx for your records.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachment: signed_poc_summary.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearcommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Apr 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap — metrics & next steps

Elena — perfect, thanks for the clear guidance and the approved quote. We’ll honor the publication notes you outlined.

Next steps on our side (mutual action plan):
- Marketing will schedule the 5-minute pre-call + 60s recording for Thu Apr 14 at 10:00 PT (link to calendar invite to follow).
- We’ll publish the case snippet with the exact quote you provided and the approved metrics, with the suggested attribution line.
- I’ve asked marketing (cc’d) to prepare a one-page highlight (PDF) for initial promotion; we’ll share the draft for your final sign-off before any public posting.

If anything changes on timing or attribution, please flag us. Appreciate you making time to help with this — it will make a big difference for teams evaluating inference economics.

Best regards,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
